body:
Heroin and acid must be one of the worst combinations ever.  I had had seven 3 inch lines of thai white heroin in the evening, along with about 4 or 5 rocks (freebase cocaine), and then took two trips. As soon as the acid kicked in i started puking (I had never puked on heroin before although my friends puke every time).  For basically my entire trip, i had no idea what was going on, and kept on losing myself totally.  I would be in one place and realise it, then what would seem like a second later i`d be somewhere totally different down the road.  This continued until i passed out and my friends drove me home.
